definitions.explanation: Describes something that is extremely strong in degree or impact, whether physical sensations, emotions, impressions, or characteristics. Often used for things that hit with great force — smells, tastes, light, personalities, or memories.

examples.japanese: {強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。

⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: We kept practicing under the intense midsummer sunlight.

notes:
USAGE:
{強烈|きょうれつ} emphasizes an overwhelming degree of strength or impact. It is commonly used with な to modify nouns and often describes sensory experiences (⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧, ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧, ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧) or abstract qualities (⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧, ⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧, ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧).
Unlike ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧, which emphasizes violent or vigorous movement, {強烈|きょうれつ} focuses on the sheer force of impact or sensation hitting the observer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧ (strong impression)
- {強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ (intense smell)
- {強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧ (intense sunlight)
- {強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧ (powerful personality)
- {強烈|きょうれつ}な⟦{一撃|いちげき}→一撃：08948_ichigeki⟧ (powerful blow)
